title: A Bow in the Clouds
paragraphs: The rain had come for so long that the world was nothing but water. Noah and his family, and all the animals, were safe in the big boat. At last the water went down, and the dry land appeared. They stepped out, and God made them a promise: never again. And as a sign God said, "I do set my bow in the cloud" (KJV). A rainbow. Not a soldier's bow, a hanging-up bow, pointed away from us, a reminder that God keeps promises. Next time you see a rainbow after rain, whether over the Radnor hills or a puddle in the road, you can say that this is God's promise, still there.
wonder: I wonder what Noah thought the first time he saw the rainbow?
activity: Colour a rainbow, or hang a prism in a window to make one on the wall.
prayer: Faithful God, you keep your promises. Help us to trust you when the storms come. Amen.
alt: A small boat on calm water beneath a soft rainbow edged with a thread of gold.
hidden: A dove carrying a leaf (very small).
translation: Retold in our own words, with a short quotation from the King James Version.
